# PowerShell

## Install

Add `rules_dx` to `MODULE.bazel`:

```python
bazel_dep(name = "rules_dx", version = "<version>")
```

Load the rules from `@rules_dx//powershell:defs.bzl`:

```python
load("@rules_dx//powershell:defs.bzl", "powershell_library", "powershell_binary", "powershell_test")
```

## Rules

### `powershell_library`

```python
powershell_library(name, srcs, visibility = None, **kwargs)
```

Minimal wrapper over pwsh_library; srcs are .ps1, .psm1 or .psd1 files.

### `powershell_binary`

```python
powershell_binary(name, *, srcs = None, visibility = None, **kwargs)
```

Binary of optional .ps1 srcs; no other defaults.

### `powershell_test`

```python
powershell_test(name, *, srcs = None, visibility = None, **kwargs)
```

Test of required .ps1 srcs, size small.

## API docs

Tool: `pwsh`.

```python
load("@rules_dx//tools/docs/powershell:defs.bzl", "powershell_doc_shard")
```

### `powershell_doc_shard`

Parses one PowerShell script module into a DocIr shard.

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `config` | `string` | no | Extra configuration identity recorded on every symbol. |
| `manifest` | `label` | no | The module manifest. Defaults to the one .psd1 in srcs, if any. |
| `package` | `string` | no | Package segment of the symbol ids. Defaults to the manifest file name. |
| `srcs` | `label_list` | yes | The module's .psm1 and every .ps1 it dot-sources, or powershell_library targets. |
| `_extract` | `label` | no |  |
| `_pwsh` | `label` | no |  |
| `_script` | `label` | no |  |

Build the docs with `tools/dx docs`; see [docs](../cli/commands/docs.md).
